The [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmer]] [[Bellek]] owned and operated a '''homestead''' on the<ref name="TNDA" /> [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], just north of the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]].<ref name="TNDA" /> In [[21 BBY/Legends|21.17 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> during a [[Mission to Tatooine (Anakin Skywalker)|hunt]] to find a worker of the [[Moisture farm/Legends|homestead]], and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] [[Raala Ponchar]], the homestead was burned down by [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s under the command of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Witch/Legends|witch]] [[Saato]].<ref name="TNDA" />
